Implemented parse_duration in solution.py covering bare integers, number+unit components (with optional spaces, fractions, and unit abbreviations/long forms, case-insensitive), ISO 8601 durations (P[nW][nD]T[nH][nM][nS]), and clock notation (hh:mm:ss or mm:ss, with minutes/seconds required below 60). Fractional totals are rounded half-up to whole seconds. Empty input, negatives, unknown units, and malformed input raise ValueError. All 17 tests in tests/ pass.
